gloss: to blow through; to pass through (of wind)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to blow through; to blow past; to sweep through
definitions.explanation: For wind or air to pass through an open space, tunnel, corridor, or similar passage.

examples.english: The wind blew through the hallway.
When I opened the window, a pleasant breeze blew through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}けて、{木|き}の{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった→舞い上がる：06043_maiagaru⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind from the sea swept through the town, sending leaves flying.

notes:
{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける is an intransitive ichidan verb, a compound of ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) and ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to pass through).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pattern: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧が〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける (the wind blows through)
- {吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind blowing through)
- ⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{抜|ぬ}ける (to blow through a valley)

RELATED WORDS:
